statement: For a compact connected effective reversible Lie group acting transitively on S^(n-1), TPI plus PCC imply n=3.
logic: TPI+PCC makes the one-point stabilizer H act freely and transitively on S^(n-2)
therefore H is diffeomorphic to S^(n-2)
connected sphere Lie groups leave n=3 or n=5
n=5 would require a compact simply connected Lie group G of dimension 7
low-dimensional compact simple-Lie-group classification rules out dimension 7
edge_correction: For connected TPI, n=2 is already excluded because a connected stabilizer cannot act transitively on S^0; a separate NCR assumption is unnecessary for this edge case.
open_dependency: Derive TPI and PCC from PDT-native primitive distinction/resource/composition principles without circularly importing three-dimensional structure.
